title: Angle bracket with a gusset

description.en: An angle bracket of 5 mm stock, 30 mm wide (Y from 0 to 30): a flat leg 50 mm along +X on the XY plane and an upright leg 40 mm high along +Z, both measured to the outside of the corner at the origin. A triangular gusset 4 mm thick, centred on the width (Y = 15), braces the inside corner; its two short sides are 25 mm long along the inside faces of the legs. Each leg has two 6.6 mm through holes 12 mm from the leg's free end and 8 mm in from each side (Y = 8 and Y = 22). Drive it by the variables leg_x, leg_z, thickness, width, gusset_leg, gusset_t, hole_d, hole_in and hole_from_end.
description.nl: Een hoeksteun uit 5 mm materiaal, 30 mm breed (Y van 0 tot 30): een plat been van 50 mm langs +X op het XY-vlak en een staand been van 40 mm hoog langs +Z, beide gemeten tot de buitenkant van de hoek in de oorsprong. Een driehoekige schoor van 4 mm dik, in het midden van de breedte (Y = 15), verstevigt de binnenhoek; zijn twee korte zijden zijn 25 mm lang langs de binnenkanten van de benen. Elk been heeft twee doorgaande gaten van 6,6 mm, 12 mm van het vrije eind van het been en 8 mm van elke zijkant (Y = 8 en Y = 22). Stuur hem met de variabelen leg_x, leg_z, thickness, width, gusset_leg, gusset_t, hole_d, hole_in en hole_from_end.

variables.name: leg_x
variables.meaning: flat leg, outside length along X

variables.name: leg_z
variables.meaning: upright leg, outside height along Z

variables.name: hole_in
variables.meaning: hole centre to the nearer side (Y)

variables.name: hole_from_end
variables.meaning: hole centre to the leg's free end

expect.value: (leg_x * thickness + (leg_z - thickness) * thickness) * width + gusset_t * gusset_leg^2 / 2 - 4 * (pi / 4 * hole_d^2 * thickness)

2 * (leg_x * thickness + (leg_z - thickness) * thickness) + 2 * (leg_x + leg_z) * width + gusset_leg^2 + gusset_leg * sqrt(2) * gusset_t - 2 * gusset_leg * gusset_t + 4 * (pi * hole_d * thickness - 2 * pi / 4 * hole_d^2)

value: (width * (leg_x * thickness * leg_x / 2 + (leg_z - thickness) * thickness * thickness / 2) + gusset_t * gusset_leg^2 / 2 * (thickness + gusset_leg / 3) - 2 * (pi / 4 * hole_d^2 * thickness) * (leg_x - hole_from_end) - 2 * (pi / 4 * hole_d^2 * thickness) * thickness / 2) / ((leg_x * thickness + (leg_z - thickness) * thickness) * width + gusset_t * gusset_leg^2 / 2 - 4 * (pi / 4 * hole_d^2 * thickness))

(width * (leg_x * thickness * thickness / 2 + (leg_z - thickness) * thickness * (thickness + leg_z) / 2) + gusset_t * gusset_leg^2 / 2 * (thickness + gusset_leg / 3) - 2 * (pi / 4 * hole_d^2 * thickness) * thickness / 2 - 2 * (pi / 4 * hole_d^2 * thickness) * (leg_z - hole_from_end)) / ((leg_x * thickness + (leg_z - thickness) * thickness) * width + gusset_t * gusset_leg^2 / 2 - 4 * (pi / 4 * hole_d^2 * thickness))

derivation: The angle is the L profile a t + (b - t) t = 425 mm^2 times w; the gusset is a right triangle with legs g, area g^2/2, times its thickness; four holes each pi d^2/4 t. V = 12750 + 1250 - 684.2 = 13315.8 mm^3.
Area: the angle's 2 Ap + 2 (a + b) w; the gusset adds its two triangles g^2 and its sloping face g sqrt(2) gt and covers 2 g gt of the legs' inner faces; each hole swaps two discs for its wall.

Centroid: the gusset's centroid is a third of its legs from the corner, at X = Z = t + g/3; the holes of the flat leg are at X = a - e, Z = t/2, those of the upright leg at X = t/2, Z = b - e. Y by symmetry.
